description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat from step 3.
